author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.56 shipped: HVAC high-draw diagnostic off the event loop
summary: HVAC high-draw diagnostic off the event loop
why: HM v2 stack samples put a ~2s loop stall 5-6s after 11/12 HVAC ticks inside _high_draw_time_s_7d: a display-only diagnostic re-walking 7 days of SPAN history per zone every 5 min on the loop. Chose hourly cache + executor over long-term statistics (statistics availability for those SPAN sensors unverified; executor+cache removes the loop cost regardless). Measured work ~44ms so the 2s is likely a GC pause the burst triggers; off-loop at 1/h cuts URA's tick-aligned share either way. Reviews caught unpatched globals in tests and a missing kWh-branch test; fixed and drilled. Full-suite name-diff clean.
implications: Shipped HVAC-A1-HIGHDRAW-PER-TICK-SCAN-1 at v5.103.56; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.56.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: HM loop_stall samples over 1h post-restart contain 0 frames in hvac_override.py _high_draw_time_s_7d

refs.release_notes: Moves the A1 7-day high-draw scan to the executor with an hourly cache; removes a ~2s loop stall on every HVAC tick.
